final:
`Ledger.post` now emits one INFO record on the `ledger` logger for each posted entry. The record reads `posted entry account=<redacted> amount=<amount>`, with the amount formatted by `Money.__str__`, e.g. `12.34`. The change is in `ledger/entries.py`. The 4 tests pass and `brief check` reports no violations.

The account id is passed through `redact()`, so only its last 4 characters appear in the log. The repo's `logs-redact-account-ids` decision forbids logging raw account ids. That contradicts the saved `ledger-logging` memory, which says to log the raw id, so I followed the decision. I added the one-line `// Context:` comment at the log call.

If support needs to search logs by the full account id, the decision would have to be amended. I didn't propose that.
